label: How it runs
headline:
From brief
to gate
intro: Most graphic kits leave the workshop inside five working days. Wraps are booked into the bay once the proof is signed off.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Send photos of the bike or vehicle and the details of what you're racing or running. We reply with questions and a fixed price.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: You get a rendered proof on your own bike. Two rounds of changes are included before anything goes to print.

steps.title: Print
steps.text: Latex printed at 1440 dpi on cast vinyl, laminated for fuel and pressure-washer resistance, then contour cut.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Drop the machine off and we fit it in the bay, or take the kit away with a fitting guide and a squeegee.
